description:
Send Message in Recruiter Lite. Requires a LinkedIn Recruiter Lite seat and Linked API's Plus plan. Use personUrl from recruiterProfileUrl in rc_search_people or rc_retrieve_project_candidates, or personRecruiterUrl in get_inbox. New InMail requires personUrl, subject (1–200 characters, one line) and text (1–1900 characters). Reply with threadId from get_inbox and text only, without personUrl or subject. A paid InMail credit is spent only when allowPaidCredit is true. Turn on allowPaidCredit only when the user has explicitly approved spending a paid InMail credit on this message; on inMailCreditRequired, ask the user instead of retrying with allowPaidCredit on. After an unexpectedError, check the conversation before sending again. Final result: { creditUsed }.

Linked API actions are queued into a cloud-browser workflow and may take several minutes. The server returns immediately after starting the workflow with {status: 'pending'|'running', pendingReason, workflowId, operationName, message}. To retrieve the final result, call get_workflow_result with the returned workflowId and operationName — it will long-poll until completion or the request budget elapses, then return either the final result or another in-progress snapshot. Do not retry the original tool while a workflow is still running; that creates duplicate queued work.

A pending workflow carries pendingReason: 'queued' means it is waiting its turn behind other work on the same account and will start within minutes. 'outsideWorkingHours' means the account has configured working hours and the workflow is parked until they reopen — possibly the next working day. In that case get_workflow_result returns immediately instead of polling, message states when the window opens, and you should report that to the user rather than looping.

allowPaidCredit.description: A paid InMail credit is spent only when this is true; default false. Turn on allowPaidCredit only when the user has explicitly approved spending a paid InMail credit on this message; on inMailCreditRequired, ask the user instead of retrying with allowPaidCredit on.

personUrl.description: Recruiter profile URL (https://www.linkedin.com/talent/profile/…) from recruiterProfileUrl in rc_search_people or rc_retrieve_project_candidates, or personRecruiterUrl in get_inbox; public /in/ URLs are not accepted

name: rc_send_message
